paper_title: Efficient Ensemble for Fine-tuning Language Models on Multiple Datasets
caption: We compare error rate (one minus accuracy), computation cost, and memory usage across our approach and baselines when fine-tuning Llama-3-8B on ten NLP tasks. MTL-FT refers to first fine-tuning a shared LoRA on all the datasets, and then fine-tuning the low-rank adapter on each dataset, while Full FT refers to full fine-tuning of the entire model. Our approach boosts the test accuracy of QLoRA by 10\% on average, only incurring 8\% additional computation and 9 GB more memory. It performs on par with the best baseline with 45\% less FLOPs.

annotations.annotation: Die Abbildung ist ein Balkendiagramm und veranschaulicht den Vergleich verschiedener Methoden anhand ihrer jeweiligen FLOP-Anzahl, dargestellt auf einer vertikalen Skala. Die horizontale Achse ist beschriftet mit 6 Kategorien: "Full FT", "TAG", "LoRA", "MTL-FT", "QLoRA" und "Ours". Die vertikale Achse trägt die Bezeichnung "# FLOPs" und verwendet eine logarithmische Skala mit Werten von 10^18, 10^19 und 10^20. Jede Kategorie hat einen orangenen Balken, mit Ausnahme von Ours, dieser ist grün. Der Balken bei Full FT ist der größte ungefähr startend zwischen 10^19 und 10^20 und danach sind die Balken absteigend.

The bar chart illustrates the comparison of different fine-tuning methods by their respective number of FLOPs, represented on a vertical scale. The horizontal axis contains the categories labeled as "Full FT", "TAG", "LoRA", "MTL-FT", "QLoRA", and "Ours" ordered from left to right, with a rotated orientation of labels. The vertical axis is labeled "# FLOPs" and uses a logarithmic scale ranging from 10^18 to 10^20, with tick labels marked at each power of ten. Each method is represented by a bar, with the first five categories ("Full FT", "TAG", "LoRA", "MTL-FT", and "QLoRA") shown in orange, while the "Ours" category is depicted in green. The "Full FT" bar is the tallest, approximately reaching 10^20 FLOPs, while the "Ours" bar, the shortest, is just above 10^18 FLOPs. No specific sorting method is applied beyond the given order, and the "Ours" bar is visually emphasized by its color and bolded label.

Хоризонталната ос е обозначена с 6 категории: „Full FT“, „TAG“, „LoRA“, „MTL-FT“, „QLoRA“ и „Наша (Ours)“. Вертикалната ос е обозначена като "# FLOPs" и използва логаритмична скала със стойности 10^18, 10^19 и 10^20. Всяка категория има оранжева лента, с изключение на „Нашата“, която е зелена. Лентата при Full FT е най-голяма, започвайки приблизително между 10^19 и 10^20, а след това лентите са надолу, като най-ниската е QLora със стойност в диапазона на 10^18, а следващата по височина е Нашата.
